description: `ErrorReportingService` observes server error output, enriches it with experience and server metadata, and posts bounded batches of Discord embeds. The Discord webhook URL is loaded from `SecretService` using the `ErrorReportingEndpoint` key by default.

ErrorReportingService.luau.description: Captures server errors and delivers bounded batches to a Discord webhook. Public entry points include `ErrorReportingService.Init`, `ErrorReportingService.Start`, `ErrorReportingService.SetEndpoint`, `ErrorReportingService.SetEndpointSecretKey`, `ErrorReportingService.SetAuthenticationSecretKey`, `promisePostReports`, `ErrorReportingService.Destroy`.

ErrorReportingUtils.luau.description: Creates structured error reports and emits fatal errors for ErrorReportingService to observe. Public entry points include `truncate`, `formatCodeBlock`, `formatInlineValue`, `formatJsonValue`, `formatStackTrace`, `formatTitle`, `sanitizeValue`, `ErrorReportingUtils.sanitizeContext`.
